  "code": """"LightGBM baseline with polynomial feature interactions."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier


def fit_predict(train_csv: str, test_rows: list[dict[str, str]]) -> list[float]:
    train = pd.read_csv(train_csv)
    y = train.pop("y").astype(int)
    test = pd.DataFrame(test_rows, columns=train.columns)
    
    # Convert numeric columns
    for name in train.columns:
        if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(train[name]):
            test[name] = pd.to_numeric(test[name])
        else:
            categories = pd.Categorical(pd.concat([train[name], test[name]], ignore_index=True)).categories
            train[name] = pd.Categorical(train[name], categories=categories)
            test[name] = pd.Categorical(test[name], categories=categories)
    
    # Find top correlated numeric feature pairs
    numeric_cols = [c for c in train.columns if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(train[c])]
    
    if len(numeric_cols) >= 2:
        corr_matrix = train[numeric_cols].corr()
        
        # Get correlation indices (lower triangle, excluding diagonal)
        indices = np.tril_indices(len(numeric_cols), k=-1)
        correlations = [(i, j, abs(corr_matrix.iloc[i, j])) 
                        for i, j in zip(indices[0], indices[1])]
        
        # Sort by absolute correlation, descending
        correlations.sort(key=lambda x: x[2], reverse=True)
        
        # Add interaction features for top correlated pairs
        top_n = min(10, len(correlations))
        for i, j, _ in correlations[:top_n]:
            col_a, col_b = numeric_cols[i], numeric_cols[j]
            inter_name = f"{col_a}_x_{col_b}"
            train[inter_name] = train[col_a] * train[col_b]
            test[inter_name] = test[col_a] * test[col_b]
    
    model = LGBMClassifier(random_state=20261114, n_jobs=1, verbosity=-1)
    model.fit(train, y)
    return model.predict_proba(test)[:, 1].tolist()",
  "notes": "Added polynomial feature interactions for top 10 most correlated numeric feature pairs. Correlations computed on training data only to avoid leakage. Interaction features created as simple products of original column values. Maintains identical function signature and output format."
}
